title: The Lantern-Bearing Fox
statement: When the first winter stole all the light from the sky, a small fox climbed the highest branch of the world-tree and hung her own lantern among the stars so the lost could find their way home. She never climbed back down; she still stands on that branch, tail curled, holding the flame — and once a year, if you watch long enough, the lantern flares and her outline runs.
